templates.specific_goal: Identify products and scan barcodes with mobile apps

templates.specific_goal: Manage communication apps on Android with accessibility
templates.measurable_metric: Client will read, compose, and manage messages and email using their AT, completing 6 tasks unassisted

templates.measurable_metric: Client will plan and follow a route with accessible map/transit apps, arriving at 2 destinations unassisted

templates.measurable_metric: Client will use TalkBack gestures for calls, messaging, and app navigation and enter text at 20 WPM, unassisted

templates.measurable_metric: Client will place calls, set reminders, and get information by voice, completing 6 tasks accurately

templates.measurable_metric: Client will use TalkBack gestures for calls, messaging, and app navigation and enter text at 20 WPM, unassisted, in 2 consecutive sessions

templates.specific_goal: Keep assistive technology updated and backed up
templates.measurable_metric: Client will update AT and the OS and verify backups, unassisted, in 2 sessions

templates.specific_goal: Set up a new device with accessibility from first boot

templates.specific_goal: Transfer settings and data to a replacement device
templates.measurable_metric: Client will migrate accounts, settings, and files to a new device using accessible methods

templates.specific_goal: Troubleshoot common device and AT problems

templates.specific_goal: Use reminder and task technology to manage daily activities
